values.task_boundary: Issue #299 archived-projection cleanup only; no #298 recovery/classification implementation and no unrelated issue mutation.
deliverables: Exact-head #119 review and publication-ready PR after gates
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Cleanup cannot start without terminal+ancestral #298 recovery authority and an exact completed recovery/canonical/archive binding.
AC-2: No recursive deletion, symlink following, digest-only ownership, path-authoritative unlink, or removal of an unrecorded inode is possible.
AC-3: Regular files, empty directories, root placeholder, per-node tombstones, and type-matched disposal counterparts follow explicit pre/post exchange and identity-specific removal states.

AC-4: Restart adopts only exact receipt-owned identities and parent manifests across terminal gate, recovery receipt load, cleanup namespace creation, capture intent, exchange, capture receipt, removal intent, unlink/rmdir, parent fsync, placeholder disposal, final receipt, and completed-repeat boundaries; collisions, replacements, unsupported types, non-empty directories, topology/ownership drift, or third states preserve everything and fail closed.
AC-5: Partial cleanup resumes at the first incomplete recorded node; repeating a complete cleanup is idempotent.
AC-6: Immutable cleanup ledger and recovery evidence survive successful cleanup.
AC-7: Unrelated sentinels and replacement inodes survive every failure and race case.
AC-8: Exact-head #119 review has no unresolved actionable finding.
dependencies: #298 terminal and ancestral to #299 execution base
Completed #298 recovery receipt and verified canonical/archive binding
Explicit release before touching projection_recovery.rs, store.rs, or gate5.rs
non_goals: Publication, merge, or closeout during preparation
Touching #298 worktree or frozen files before explicit release
